notes.title: Ver0.3 update
notes.content:
This is a major update, this update completes the first half of the first chapter

Completed the map of the star system Weitouma

Completed the old Imperial Ritual Costume of Cheng Lin Xing, which can be obtained in the Weitouma system.

Completed the Saito storyline

Finished the first half of the Minamoto Syuku episode

Completed 2 sets of dynamic cg's for Cheng Lin Xing, 1 set of static cg's can be viewed in the research bay of the ship, the new dynamic cg's are on the second page of dynamic cg options.

The next version will complete the plot of Minamoto Syuku and the character of Minamoto Syuku can control and join the ship.

notes.title: 8-10 mini-patches
notes.content:
Fixed all bugs reported,
including equipment drop bugs,
Character exception bug,
Map refresh bug

The next major update will be completed within August

notes.title: June 13 update content
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after 3 months of epidemic, we have finally finished the v0.27 version,
This version adds the prosthetic system and branching content,
We have added the prosthetic system and branching content, and made the prosthetic body fit all the costumes, and we have also made the cg of the prosthetic system,
You can buy through the planet's armor store
The plot content is completed to the second half of the first chapter, after the next update,
We will complete the first chapter of the content, open more open planet content

After 3 months of epidemic, the production team has not fully recovered from the production function,
But we will continue to complete the game content, thank you for your support

notes.title: 22/3/18 Bug fix
notes.content:
Fixed the bug of the branch line of Hesperia
Fixed display bugs
Fixed combat bugs

notes.title: March Update Preview
notes.content:
The main content of this version of the update for the rest of the star branch,
This update will include Carrie plot cg 
Chen Lin xing follow-up full cg completed, Chen Lin xing plot content will be updated 2 sets of clothing, a set will have dynamic cg

New female character layout into the game
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359193/35889f02166ac722c4ae2382aaf782e623430093.png[/img]

Cheeky Lin Shue plot cg exposure
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359193/dfa69c6298231693c86a2fb6ceb67c4b79cb73b2.png[/img]

There is a question about why the update speed has slowed down
We have completed the reset of the combat system according to your demand,
Optimized the feel and operation,
And we made the item drop, so players don't need to pick up the equipment.

We also finished the optimization of the kernel, so that it runs faster
This update will be completed and released in March, thank you for waiting!

notes.title: December update content
notes.content:
Version 0.2 update preview
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359193/df33dd2f85f02101985ac7b3e9e73a89bd4ff913.png[/img]
Hello everyone, 
We've finished our long overdue December update, 
This update contains 15,000 words of plot, 
New 10 sets of Cheng Lin Xing cg, 2 sets of dynamic cg,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359193/2d443f4b22b2f20e3bfc8050d24642bc80d2e960.png[/img]

To make up for the long wait, 
We have finished all the upper and lower limbs and dynamic cg of Cheng Linxing, 
We hope you will have fun, 

Our next update is expected to be around February, 
We will continue to enrich the playability of the planet for the next update.

notes.title: About the November update
notes.content:
We are very sorry, but due to our miscalculation and revenue issues
Some of our graphic renderers and programmers have left the team

Our revenue in October and November was not enough to cover the cost of the rendering staff.
Therefore, the development of the game has been affected by the departures.
But we will continue to update and work on it, we hope you will trust us.

Here are some screenshots of the new version

The new version of the planet map:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359193/599236579493878cc0ce12ade1fefcc5dbf86adf.png[/img]

New version of the female character:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359193/9005cb5ab40cc3eefe73ab9d03e90d2b1096e394.png[/img]

We hope you will forgive us and we will speed up the production, thank you!

notes.content:
